_meta.description: Weekly maximum rainfall (mm) and wind speed (km/h) for 30 Indonesian kecamatan. Synthetic fixture anchored to BMKG climatological norms: Jakarta/Surabaya rainy season Nov–Mar (weeks 44–52, 1–12); Medan longer wet season. High-risk districts (flood_risk ≥ 0.65) have 6–8 exceedance weeks/year (>150mm or >60km/h) per the build plan. Used by the insurance agent to evaluate parametric trigger precision.
